strings.alwaysshowdefinition: Allow users to preview rubric (otherwise it will only be displayed after grading)
strings.confirmdeletecriterion: Are you sure you want to delete this criterion?
strings.confirmdeletelevel: Are you sure you want to delete this level?
strings.enableremarks: Allow grader to add text remarks for each criterion
strings.err_mintwolevels: Each criterion must have at least two levels
strings.err_nocriteria: Rubric must contain at least one criterion
strings.err_nodefinition: Level definition can not be empty
strings.err_nodescription: Criterion description can not be empty
strings.err_novariations: Criterion levels cannot all be worth the same number of points
strings.err_scoreformat: Number of points for each level must be a valid number
strings.err_totalscore: Maximum number of points possible when graded by the rubric must be more than zero
strings.lockzeropoints: Calculate grade having a minimum score of the minimum achievable grade for the rubric
strings.lockzeropoints_help: This setting only applies if the sum of the minimum number of points for each criterion is greater than 0. If ticked, the minimum score of the activity will be the minimum achievable grade for the rubric. If unticked, the minimum possible score for the rubric will be mapped to the minimum grade available for the activity (which is 0 unless a scale is used).
strings.name: Name
strings.needregrademessage: The rubric definition was changed after this student had been graded. The student can not see this rubric until you check the rubric and update the grade.
strings.privacy:metadata:criterionid: An identifier for a specific criterion being graded.
strings.privacy:metadata:fillingssummary: Stores information about the user's grade created by the rubric.
strings.privacy:metadata:instanceid: An identifier relating to a grade in an activity.
strings.privacy:metadata:levelid: The level obtained in the rubric.
strings.privacy:metadata:remark: Remarks related to the rubric criterion being assessed.
strings.regrademessage1: You are about to save changes to a rubric that has already been used for grading. Please indicate if existing grades need to be reviewed. If you set this then the rubric will be hidden from students until their item is regraded.
strings.regrademessage5: You are about to save significant changes to a rubric that has already been used for grading. The gradebook value will be unchanged, but the rubric will be hidden from students until their item is regraded.
strings.restoredfromdraft: NOTE: The last attempt to grade this person was not saved properly so draft grades have been restored. If you want to cancel these changes use the 'Cancel' button below.
strings.rubricmappingexplained: The minimum possible score for this rubric is {$a->minscore} points. It will be converted to the minimum grade available for the activity (which is 0 unless a scale is used). The maximum score of {$a->maxscore} points will be converted to the maximum grade. Intermediate scores will be converted respectively. If a scale is used for grading, the score will be rounded and converted to the scale elements as if they were consecutive integers. This grade calculation may be changed by editing the form and ticking the box 'Calculate grade having a minimum score of the minimum achievable grade for the rubric'.
strings.rubricnotcompleted: Please choose something for each criterion
strings.saverubric: Save rubric and make it ready
strings.showdescriptionstudent: Display rubric description to those being graded
strings.showremarksstudent: Show remarks to those being graded
strings.showscorestudent: Display points for each level to those being graded
strings.showscoreteacher: Display points for each level during evaluation
strings.zerolevelsabsent:
Warning: The minimum possible score for this rubric is not 0; this can result in unexpected grades for the activity. To avoid this, each criterion should have a level with 0 points.
This warning may be ignored if a scale is used for grading, and the minimum levels in the rubric correspond to the minimum value of the scale.
